verdict.rationale: The Pipecat Cloud pricing page lists a first-party Krisp-powered noise-cancellation feature that removes background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, so the capability exists for this story. The only evidence is that one marketing-level mention, and it applies only to the Cloud offering. missing for 10: documentation on how a developer enables or configures noise suppression or audio filtering in a pipeline, evidence of a filter option in the open-source framework, any technical depth or settings, independent or hands-on corroboration that it keeps agents coherent on noisy calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls

citations.quote: Eliminates background noise and voices that cause false interruptions, powered by Krisp.
